name: Teresa Hsu
tagline: She ate grass as a child in Swatow and spent the next century making sure no one else had to.

cloth.why: Her Singapore work (the 1965 Home for the Aged Sick, the Heart to Heart rounds) falls in the nation-building era. The colour is a warm terracotta, like the Society for the Aged Sick's tiled roofs and a cooking pot, and is softer than the red accents on the other spines. Her first chapter is 1898, so clothFor would default to the colonial palette; override it if the warmer cloth is wanted.
